# Silicons

Lets synths and IPCs recharge by draining a power cell or a wall APC. A synth's cell sits in an organ slot, which the
stock battery drinker can't find, so `SynthBatteryDrinkerSystem` answers `GetDrinkerBatteryEvent` with it. The event
is raised by a marked edit in the Einstein Engines `BatteryDrinkerSystem`, which falls back to the stock lookup when
nothing answers. `SynthRechargeTest` covers both sources.
